note: The St Helena Currency Ordinance, 1975 (consolidated text of 7 July 2025, published by the St Helena Government), section 4, gives the St Helena pound parity with the pound sterling, and section 12 binds the Commissioners of Currency to buy and sell sterling at that parity; read 2026-10-30. Ascension uses the St Helena pound under the Currency (Ascension) Ordinance, 2009.

sources.title: Currency Ordinance, 1975 (St Helena, consolidated 2025-07-07)
sources.said: The unit of currency of St Helena is the St Helena pound ... The St Helena pound is to have parity with the pound sterling. ... The Commissioners must on demand buy or sell sterling for immediate
